name: Vancouver
tagline: A city between ocean and mountains
summary: Cycle the seawall, eat at Granville Island and spend a day in the North Shore mountains. The city is compact and outdoor life is the main attraction.
seasonNote: October to March is rainy; summer is dry, sunny and the peak for cruises.
arrival: The Canada Line SkyTrain reaches downtown from the airport in 25 minutes.
gettingAround: Walk, cycle or use SkyTrain, buses and the SeaBus with a contactless card.
cashTip: Cards work everywhere; tip 15 to 20% in restaurants.
foodTip: Try sushi, wild salmon, dim sum in Richmond and a Japadog.
buyTip: Indigenous art from galleries that name the artist, maple syrup and smoked salmon.
baseArea: Downtown, the West End or Yaletown

connections.note: About 9 hours' drive; or fly to Calgary and drive 90 minutes.

items.name: Stanley Park Seawall
items.summary: A 9 km waterfront path around a forested peninsula, passing totem poles and beaches.
items.expect: The cycling lane is one-way, anticlockwise.
items.tip: Rent a bike on Denman Street and allow 90 minutes with stops.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult in local currency, not a live ticket quote; check current prices and what is included.

whyVisit: A 9 km waterfront path around a forested peninsula, passing totem poles and beaches.
The best way to see the city, mountains and harbour together.
visitFlow: Rent a bike near the park entrance.
Stop at the totem poles and Prospect Point.
items.bestFor: Visitors interested in landscapes and wildlife and big views
tradeoffs: The cycling lane is one-way, anticlockwise.
